# Stefanini Group

> Stefanini Group is a global AI-first technology consultancy delivering enterprise solutions across cloud, automation, cybersecurity, and industry-specific digital transformation services.

Stefanini Group offers comprehensive technology consulting and managed services to enterprises worldwide, with specialized solutions for manufacturing, financial services, healthcare, retail, and public sectors. The company leverages AI, IoT, and cloud technologies to drive digital transformation and operational excellence.

## Key Topics

- Artificial Intelligence (AI)
- Cloud Enablement & Migration
- Internet of Things (IoT)
- Digital Transformation
- Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure
- Cybersecurity & GRC
- Smart Manufacturing (Industry 4.0)
- Data Analytics & Business Intelligence
- Automation & Process Optimization
- Financial Technology (FinTech)
- SAI Platform (Stefanini AI)
- Enterprise Services
- Supply Chain Optimization
- Customer Experience
- Cloud Migration Strategy

## Core Solutions & Platforms

- [Artificial Intelligence Solutions](https://stefanini.com/en/solutions/artificial-intelligence): AI solutions platform featuring SAI Platform, APP, CYBER, and DW products for enterprise transformation
- [Next Gen Applications](https://stefanini.com/en/solutions/next-gen-applications): Next Gen Applications solution with Digital AMS and Software Factory for modern application development
- [Cloud Enablement](https://stefanini.com/en/solutions/cloud-enablement): Cloud Enablement services covering IaaS, PaaS, and comprehensive cloud migration strategy
- [Hybrid Infrastructure](https://stefanini.com/en/solutions/hybrid-infrastructure): Hybrid Infrastructure solution featuring Smart Enterprise Services and AI-powered technology
- [Data Analytics Services](https://stefanini.com/en/solutions/analytics): Data Analytics services delivering business intelligence, predictive insights, and data-driven decision making

## Enterprise & Security Services

- [Cybersecurity Solutions](https://stefanini.com/en/solutions/cybersecurity): Cybersecurity solutions with managed services, threat defense, and governance, risk, compliance (GRC) offerings
- [Modern Enterprise Services](https://stefanini.com/en/solutions/modern-enterprise-services): Modern Enterprise Services with SD-WAN, Zero-Trust architecture, and SASE security framework
- [Digital Workplace and Infrastructure](https://stefanini.com/en/solutions/workplace-and-infrastructure): Digital Workplace solution with Emotion AI and Stefanini d³ technology for employee engagement
- [Consulting Services](https://stefanini.com/en/solutions/consulting-services): Consulting services for organizational and technological transformation strategy

## Industry-Specific Solutions

- [Smart Manufacturing](https://stefanini.com/en/solutions/automation-everywhere/smart-manufacturing): Smart Manufacturing for Industry 4.0 with SAI Plant Assistant, IoT sensors, and predictive maintenance
- [Financial Technology](https://stefanini.com/en/solutions/financial-technology-topaz): FinTech solutions including Topaz One, FinChannels, and advanced payment processing platforms
- [Digital Marketing Solutions](https://stefanini.com/en/solutions/digital-marketing): Full-service Digital Marketing with SAI Marketing for brand awareness, engagement, and customer acquisition
- [Smart Operations](https://stefanini.com/en/solutions/operations): Smart Operations BPO service combining AI and intelligent automation for operational efficiency

## Vertical Markets

- [Industrial Goods](https://stefanini.com/en/industry/industrial-goods): Industrial Goods industry solutions with IoT integration, AI analytics, and smart manufacturing capabilities
- [Consumer Products](https://stefanini.com/en/industry/consumer-products): Consumer Products solutions for demand forecasting, supply chain optimization, and market intelligence
- [Consumer Services](https://stefanini.com/en/industry/consumer-services): Consumer Services solutions for enhanced customer experience and operational efficiency
- [Life Sciences](https://stefanini.com/en/industry/smart-offer-for-life-science): Life Sciences solutions for digital health, clinical trials management, and medical device innovation
- [Natural Resources](https://stefanini.com/en/industry/natural-resources): Natural Resources industry solutions with IoT monitoring and sustainability optimization
- [Public and Social Sector](https://stefanini.com/en/industry/public-and-social-sector): Public Sector solutions with SophieX AI assistant and comprehensive digital transformation services
